Field Name
Field Description
AppTrusted
A boolean value that indicates whether the CrowdStrike Falcon app is trusted as determined by the Android Play Integrity
Attestation APIs.
0: The app isn’t trusted
1: The app is trusted
ContextTimeStamp
System time of event creation.
IsEcho
Indicates if the same event was sent before.
MeetsBasicIntegrity
The result of a more lenient verdict for device integrity. Returned by Google Play Integrity Attestation API.
MeetsDeviceIntegrity
The result of a stricter verdict for device integrity. Returned by Google Play Integrity Attestation API.
